Cold workspace to
documents processing.

Your workspace is empty right now: no app, no warehouse, no schema, no agents. Follow these six steps and you will be watching documents move through Agent Bricks in about fifteen minutes.

6 steps0 or 1 commands 2 buttons to pressrun takes ~2 min
1

Install it

4 to 6 min

Pick whichever suits the workspace you are in. Both end in the same place.

A · From Git, no command line at all. Best in a customer workspace, or on any machine without the Databricks CLI.

  1. In the Databricks workspace: Workspace, Create, Git folder, paste the repo URL, Create. A public repo needs no credentials.
  2. Open setup_databricks.py inside the clone and press Run all.

The notebook runs as you, which is what makes this work: it creates the app, deploys the code straight out of the Git folder, then grants the app the two rights it needs to set the workspace up for itself. It finishes by printing a link to the app.

To update later: press Pull in the Git folder, then run the notebook again.

B · One command, if you have the CLI.

paste into terminal
cd ~/projects/agentbricks-doc-demo && python3 install.py

Does exactly the same three things, and prints the app URL when it finishes.

2

Open it

1 min

Open your app URL. You land on Start. The left side is the setup form, the right side is the readiness panel, and it should be unhappy. That is the point.

✓App identity resolvespassing
!Serverless SQL warehouseapp creates it
!Catalog workspace.docflowapp creates it
!Document volume writableapp creates it
✓Foundation models reachablepassing
○Knowledge Assistantmade on Go
○Information Extraction agentsteps only
!Document Intelligence functionsself-tests after
○Billed usage availableinformational
What you are looking at

Left side, the only two things you have to answer. Right side, one card telling you what this workspace is missing and offering to fix it. Go is greyed out until both sides are happy, and the sentence beside it always says exactly what is holding it up.

3

Press one button

1 min

The app tells you what the workspace is missing in plain language, and offers to fix all of it at once.

Set up this workspaceCreates everything the demo needs About 45 seconds. Each piece reports for itself underneath, so if one fails you know which.
What it just made

A 2X-Small serverless warehouse that stops itself after 10 idle minutes, a schema for the tables and Genie space, and a volume with folders for documents. When it finishes the card turns green and says the workspace is ready.

Curious what it checked? Open See all 9 checks for the full list, including the two optional ones the app cannot create for you.

4

Two answers

30 sec

Left side. These drive everything the run generates.

FieldWhat it changes
Customer nameAppears on every page and inside every generated document
IndustryThe vocabulary, the suggested questions, and the titles of both operations pages
Catalog and schemaWhere the tables, Genie space and run state live
DocumentsLeave as generate everything, or point at a volume of the customer's own PDFs
Try something other than Manufacturing

Insurance gives you "Loss Run Review" and vocabulary like subrogation and loss run. Logistics gives you "Freight Claims Recovery Desk". It is the most convincing thirty seconds of the demo and it costs nothing to try.

Press Save. It flashes Saved. Go is now enabled.

5

Press Go

~2 min

The run log takes over the right side and streams with real timings.

AtWhat happens
~8sSchema, volume and tables confirmed
~16sCompany research, using a model on the AI Gateway
~34sDocuments generated, watermarked, into their own folder
~35sKnowledge Assistant created, indexing starts in the background
~36 to 120sDocuments processed: parse, classify, route, extract, audit, secure
~120sGenie space created over the extracted tables, then Ready

Switch to Flow while it runs. This is the screen to show a customer.

6

The payoff

3 min

Three screens carry the story once the run is done.

Ask — the suggestions under the box are written for your industry and are guaranteed answerable from the data this run produced.

Claims and Suppliers are the two operations screens. Built lists everything the run created with per section timings.

✓

Stand it down

10 sec

Nothing bills while idle. The warehouse stops itself after 10 minutes and Databricks stops the app 24 hours after deploy. To stop both immediately:

paste into terminal
databricks apps stop docflow
If a fix button fails

The message leads with what to do about it, and Databricks' own wording sits behind a "what Databricks reported" disclosure. Usually it means step 3 was skipped or did not finish.

Every screenshot on this page is a real capture of the app running against a Databricks workspace. Nothing is mocked up.
